events.content:
I want a small Next.js app for keeping track of the books I'm reading.

When I open it I want to see what I'm currently reading and what I've finished. I want to add a book from a form, mark one as finished, and click through to a book to see its title, author and my notes. I'd like to be able to send someone a link to a single book.

Nothing fancy and no accounts. Skip the database, save the books to a JSON file so they're still there after a restart.
I'll start by checking the workspace, then build a small Next.js book tracker that stores books in a JSON file.
The workspace is mostly empty, so I'll add a small Next.js app that keeps books in a local JSON file.

events.content:
The reading list is a small Next.js app. Books live in data/books.json, so they stay after a restart. There are no accounts.

Open the app and you get two lists: currently reading and finished. The form adds a book with title, author, and notes. Mark finished moves it to the finished list. Each book has its own page at /books/[id], so you can send that link to someone.

npm run build completed successfully (exit 0). Start it with npm run dev.
